@skipAuth.summary: Marks a field, object, or interface as exempt from complete-protection authentication checks.

authors.intro: Import with `@link(url: "https://specs.graphql-mesh.dev/auth/v0.1", import: ["@skipAuth"])` and `@composeDirective` when the Supergraph must carry it. Place on fields/types that must remain reachable when the gateway otherwise requires authentication on every field. Combine with Federation `@authenticated` / `@requiresScopes` / `@policy` as needed.

implementers.intro: When complete-protection auth is active, skip authentication/authorization checks for locations annotated with `@skipAuth`. No arguments. Locations without the directive remain subject to the default policy.
implementers.compose: Preserve `@skipAuth` on the Supergraph (`@composeDirective` or equivalent).
implementers.runtime: During auth enforcement, treat annotated fields/types/interfaces as exempt. Unannotated neighbors still require auth.
implementers.validation: No arguments allowed. Location must be FIELD_DEFINITION, OBJECT, or INTERFACE.
